content:
omar: Heads-up: Lumenix (acct LU-128) says INV-2026-412 charged them for both Reserved-S and a mid-month upgrade to Reserved-M, but they only intended the upgrade to start 2026-08-16. Invoice shows S charged for full month + M pro-rated. They want us to re-evaluate.
tess: Can you attach the signed amendment? Need effective date stamp.
omar: Uploaded Lumenix_AMEND_0816.pdf 926. Effective 2026-08-16 per signature.
billing-bot: Metering snapshot (Aug 01-31) for LU-128:
```
2026-08-01,committed_units,burst_units
2026-08-01,400000,60000
2026-08-17,600000,180000
2026-08-28,600000,22000
TOTAL,600000,262000
```
liam: Invoice INV-2026-412 lines pasted: 
```
Line A: RSRV-S-2026, qty 1, period 2026-08-01 - 2026-08-31, amt $6,000
Line B: RSRV-M-2026, qty 1, period 2026-08-16 - 2026-08-31, amt $6,000
Line C: OVG-TOK, 262,000 tokens, amt $1,572
Total $13,572
```
tess: Hmm billing engine should only bill S for Aug1-15 and M from 16-31. If it billed S for full month *and* M for half-month we double-counted S for the upgrade window. Need to compute correct proration and delta.
liam: Pricing table: RSRV-S = $6k/mo, RSRV-M = $10k/mo. Daily S (Aug31)=6000/31=193.55, daily M=10000/31=322.58. Prorated: S for Aug1-15 = 15*193.55 = $2,903.25. M for Aug16-31 = 16*322.58 = $5,160.96. Correct reserved charge = $8,064.21. Current billed reserved lines sum = $12,000 (6k + 6k). Delta reserved overcharge = $3,935.79.
omar: Customer also points out token usage spike around Aug17 migration. AM verbally agreed to a one-time migration buffer of 150k tokens. Overage rate for LU-128 is $0.006/token -> 150k * 0.006 = $900. Current OVG-TOK was 262k * 0.006 = $1,572. So net overage after buffer = (262k - 150k) * 0.006 = 112k*0.006 = $672. But since we already billed $1,572 and the agreed buffer was to waive 150k, we should credit $900.
tess: So suggested credit = reserved delta $3,935.79 + buffer $900 = $4,835.79. Under $5k threshold by narrow margin.
zoe: Quick check: Did sales record the buffer in deal notes? I see a comment "migration buffer: 150k tokens" in opportunity OP-799.
ops-lead: Also check SLA ask: they reported 5 minutes of elevated error rates during the cutover. Our SLA policy requires incident verification for credits. Ops shows a small error spike but no availability breach; no auto SLA credit.
liam: I'll draft CM for $4,835.79 with reason "proration correction + agreed migration buffer". No manager escalation needed but cc finance_mgr for visibility.
finance_mgr: FYI approved (email thread) for amounts < $5k. Leave approval id blank in doc as not required by system.
tess: Draft CM-2026-039 for $4,835.79 and attach amendment, metering CSV, AM note. Posting to AR.
liam: Reissued invoice INV-2026-412-R1 created showing credit line (-$4,835.79). New total $8,736.21. Marking original as superseded.
omar: Sending customer note: "We reviewed your amendment and migration buffer. We've issued credit CM-2026-039 and reissued invoice INV-2026-412-R1. Please confirm receipt."
zoe: Customer replied: "Thanks, updated amount looks right. Appreciate the migration concession and quick turnaround." :thumbsup:
tess: Logged BILL-2026-420 with attachments (AMEND, CM, INV-R1, metering). Closing once cash reconciliation complete.
liam: AR posted credit TX-AR-100221.
omar: Closing thread.
